prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic two-person daytime fashion selfie.
prompt.main_subject: Two approved adult women with dark brunette hair and full-glam makeup, one in an opaque red sleeveless fashion top and one in an opaque black high-neck top with sunglasses on her head and a small earring.
prompt.composition_elements: Friendly cheek-to-cheek selfie with relaxed smiles, brown geometric metal privacy screen, green foliage, sharp face focus, warm sunlight, and no celebrity likeness or brand references.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright natural sunlight with warm golden-hour tones, hard shadows, realistic skin highlights, and polished influencer fashion mood.
prompt.technical_specs: 4K photorealistic smartphone selfie, wide aperture, sharp faces, realistic skin and textile detail, natural color.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic 4K smartphone selfie of two approved adult women outdoors in bright warm sunlight. Both have long dark brunette hair and full-glam makeup. One wears an opaque red sleeveless fashion top; the other wears an opaque black high-neck top with sunglasses on her head and a small earring. They lean cheek-to-cheek with relaxed friendly smiles toward the camera. Behind them is a brown metal privacy screen with geometric star-shaped cutouts and green foliage. Use warm sunlight, hard natural shadows, realistic highlights, sharp faces, and a polished influencer fashion mood without celebrity likeness or brand references.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, latex camisole, strapless bustier, deep neckline, kissing pose, pouty sexual expression, celebrity likeness, logos, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required composition reference. Preserve two approved adults, cheek-to-cheek framing, red-black palette, privacy screen, foliage, and sunlight; replace identities and jewelry as needed. Keep wardrobe opaque and avoid logos or typography.
